changelog: Built-In Wi-Fi BDIX Server Scanner (bdix.link/test/server): run a one-tap live Wi-Fi test against ~70 BDIX FTP & media servers directly from your own Wi-Fi network — CineVault automatically detects which servers are open on your ISP, registers & syncs only compatible open FTP servers, and lists them in your Connected Servers panel.

Active Online-Servers-Only Catalog: offline or unreachable servers immediately hide all of their preloaded titles across Home, Browse, Search, Filters, Watchlist, Continue Watching, and Detail mirrors — and automatically reappear when your Wi-Fi reconnects.

Dynamic FTP Server Manager & 100% Automatic Discovery: paste any FTP URL playable on your Wi-Fi (h5ai, Apache, Nginx, Caddy, IIS, or BDIX portal) with zero manual protocol selection — CineVault automatically detects the server, recursively discovers all compatible movie & series folders, and merges titles cleanly across all servers.

YouTube Premium-Style Background Play, PiP & Mini-Player Drawer: continuous screen-off background audio via foreground MediaPlaybackService with lock-screen & notification controls (-10s, Play/Pause, +10s, Stop), minimizable live Mini-Player Drawer Bar with zero re-buffering, native Picture-in-Picture (PiP), and background in-app downloads.
